comment: Deliberate corrections applied when reading the snapshot. The snapshot itself
stays a verbatim export; every departure from it is recorded here so it is
reviewable and survives a refresh. Each entry names an upstream defect --
see spec/README.md -- and is removed once upstream fixes it.

blank_presence.reason: Column-shifted row: the field name and description are pasted into the two presence columns, so neither holds a presence value. Blanked rather than guessed -- upstream does not say which point types carry impediment.
